The lamp would guide; the letter would reach.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台调低了音量的机器。路灯还亮着，把空荡的街道拉得很长。环卫工人的扫帚声有节奏地响着，远处偶尔驶过一辆出租车，车灯划破薄雾。便利店透出暖黄的光，值夜班的店员靠在柜台后打盹。写字楼在深蓝色的天幕下沉睡，只有零星几扇窗还亮着。早点铺的蒸笼冒出第一缕白汽，水即将沸腾。城市尚未醒来，却已在悄悄准备，迎接黎明。", "w03": "• Imagine you're in a line of kids, and everyone only knows how to ask the kid in front: 'what's your number?'\n• Eventually you reach the last kid, who just knows the answer (number one!) without asking anyone — that's the stopping point.\n• The answers then travel back one kid at a time, each person adding one, until your question is answered — recursion is just solving a big problem by passing a smaller copy of it forward and combining what comes back."}
